records.source_span: I wanted to talk about this Portuguese writing course I just signed up for. It's through a platform called WriteInPT. I enrolled on May 8th and it's an eight-week program. The instructor is Professor Cláudia Mendes.
records.value: WriteInPT Portuguese writing course, 8-week program, enrolled May 8th, instructor Professor Cláudia Mendes

records.source_span: I specifically chose a course focused on Brazilian Portuguese because I have zero interest in European Portuguese grammar drills
before the course started I took the vocabulary placement test for the WriteInPT course and scored 74 out of 100
I grew up speaking Brazilian Portuguese at home in São Paulo until I was about eleven, so it was deeply ingrained.
records.value: grew up speaking Brazilian Portuguese at home in São Paulo until about age eleven

records.source_span: living in the US for so long, things slip
remember my cousin Renata in Lisbon? She actually signed up for the WriteInPT course too, the same one I'm taking. Renata told me she scored 73 out of 100 on the WriteInPT vocabulary placement test.
records.value: cousin Renata lives in Lisbon, enrolled in same WriteInPT course, scored 73/100 on placement test

records.source_span: I started doing weekly Sunday calls with my grandmother in São Paulo back in late February, right after Carnaval.
records.value: weekly Sunday calls with grandmother in São Paulo, started late February after Carnaval

records.source_span: She doesn't speak any English at all, so the entire conversation is always in Portuguese. We talk every Sunday around 2 PM her time.

records.source_span: going from 72 down to 68 because of a recalculation on the idiomatic expressions section

records.source_span: So I had my second WriteInPT class this week and it went well. Professor Cláudia had us do a free-writing exercise about a childhood memory, and I wrote about Carnaval in São Paulo when I was eight or nine.
records.value: attended second WriteInPT class; wrote free-writing exercise about childhood Carnaval memory in São Paulo at age 8-9

records.source_span: She said my descriptive vocabulary was strong but I need to work on verb conjugation consistency — I apparently slipped between present and past tense a few times without realizing.
records.value: strong descriptive vocabulary; needs to work on verb conjugation/tense consistency

records.source_span: Professor Cláudia said there might be another adjustment because some students appealed, and if the appeal goes through my score would go back up to 72.
records.value: possible score adjustment back to 72 pending appeal review

records.source_span: my mom mentioned last week she's been mixing up Portuguese and English more than usual — she called a garfo a fork mid-sentence while talking to my aunt and didn't even notice. She's been in the US over twenty years so I guess that's expected.
records.value: mother has been living in the US over twenty years; mixes Portuguese and English
